# Background-removal corpus — provenance

## Checked-in fixtures

| File | Source | License | Notes |
|------|--------|---------|-------|
| `car.jpg`, `cat.jpg`, `human.jpg`, `object.jpg` | Pexels (free for personal and commercial use) | [Pexels License](https://www.pexels.com/license/) | Real photographs; used as reference inputs for regression. |
| `reference/` | Generated by `scripts/bench/bgremove-reference/generate_fixtures.py` + `run_reference.py` | CC0 (synthetic) | Deterministic, seed-locked; masks from U²-NetP are NOT ground truth. |
| `synthetic/` | Generated by `scripts/bench/bgremove-reference/generate_fixtures.py` | CC0 (synthetic) | Exact RGB/RGBA fixtures with ground-truth alpha in PNG channel. |
| `corpus.json` | Schema + hygiene contract for CI | N/A (machine-readable manifest) | Documents mask classification tiers and metric schema. |

## Held-out evaluation set

Large or licensed corpora stay outside Git. The checked-in set is
intentionally small and legally redistributable. See `README.md` for the
full evaluation protocol and the required held-out set categories.
